rule: Held-out paraphrases (LOG-0037 limit 4): written once, before any run, and never used while iterating prompts, fixtures or system code. Utterances never name a capability id, package or tool. Expected capability and exact arguments are evaluator-only and never sent to the system under test. A run on this set is a reported measurement and never gate evidence.
